text:
maria: Starting a thread to lock down the internal announce for v2.14.0. Change window Wed 10:00 PT. Need: 1-paragraph blurb, canary steps, exact rollback criteria, and the deploybot commands.
samir: Request: pin hosted model to v2.14.0-rc3. No auto-latest drift during rollout.
devon_ops: Agreed. I'll put the pin in the deploy sequence. Also will publish the exact /deploy commands so oncall can replay.
anna: Blurb draft: 'v2.14.0 patch: reduced embedding latency, improved long-context decoding stability, and a tokenization fix that resolves rare OOVs. No API changes. Rolling canary with smoke-suite gating.' Thoughts?
cheng: Add measured perf: embedding p50 ~20% lower and decode p95 improved ~10% (if bench numbers hold).
maria: I'll pull numbers from the benchmark doc and slot them into the blurb. Devon paste the deploy steps?
devon_ops: Sequence we'll run:
```
/deploy start v2.14.0 --pin v2.14.0-rc3 --canary 10 --wait 10m
/check-eval regressions --suite release-smoke
/deploy promote --percent 50 --wait 15m
/check-eval regressions --suite release-smoke
/deploy promote --percent 100
```
Rollback command: `/deploy rollback v2.14.0-rc2`
Note: after any failed smoke check we abort and rollback.
samir: Rollback thresholds proposal: if latency p95 rises >15% OR smoke-suite correctness drop >2% OR errors spike >3x baseline => rollback. Also page app owners (samir) and ops (devon_ops) immediately.
deploy-bot: Job queued by devon_ops. ID db-7821. Will start when slot free.
lexi: Small request: can we run a staging dry-run in eu-west 24h prior? Last time regional KV expiries showed up only in that region.
maria: Good catch. Schedule: Tue 10:00 PT staging dry-run (eu-west). devon_ops will monitor. Add this to the announce.
anna: Communication plan: post in #eng-releases and #all-hands 2h before window; include exact timeline, canary percentages, monitoring links, and rollback contacts.
cheng: Who is oncall for Tue dry-run and Wed launch? devon_ops for Tue, and oncall rotation covers Wed (eng-oncall + eng-sre).
devon_ops: I'll take Tue dry-run and will tag eng-sre for Wed. I'll also attach the monitoring dashboard and create the alert rules now.
maria: Drafting final announce now. Will include: blurb, bench numbers, deploy commands, rollback thresholds, staging dry-run, contact list, and runbook link. Posting in ~25m for quick review.
samir: Tiny wording nit: replace 'smoke-suite gating' with 'smoke-suite gating (automated)' so it's clear it's enforced by CI.
maria: updated. Also adding the canary/rollback matrix table to the pinned timeline.
deploy-bot: Canary started for db-7821 at 1786550400. 10% traffic -> v2.14.0-rc3.
lexi: Watching dashboards now. Will shout if p95 climbs.
devon_ops: Reminder: after each promote we run `/check-eval regressions --suite release-smoke` and wait for green. If noisy alerts from infra, use the ops-runbook escalation path.
maria: Thanks all. If no objections I'll post the announce draft in 25m. Ping me for wording nits. :thumbsup:
